target_state: Enterprise-Grade Autonomous Database Diagnostics & Controlled Self-Evolving Agent (BYOK Model API Ready)
strategic_shift_note: Project model strategy pivoted to Enterprise BYOK (Bring Your Own Key/API): enterprises connect their own OpenAI-compatible/cloud/on-prem LLM APIs via runtime management APIs. Custom LoRA/SFT training is demoted from mandatory to OPTIONAL (only for constrained on-prem small-model appliances). Domain adaptation relies on Controlled Self-Evolution (LLM Wiki + Hybrid RAG + Multi-Confirmation).

completed_phases: P1-T1 (commit dd6d03d: OpenAICompatibleAdapter + ModelRoleRouter + RedactionGate assertion hardening)
P1-T2 (commit 3910320: AGENT benchmark runner + compressed tool catalog + 9 MySQL baseline COMPLETED)
P2-T1 (commit f69c9f5: ENV-PG5432 unblocked with postgres:16.4 + pg_stat_statements + streaming SSE timeout + dual-engine execution)
P2-T1B (commit eb17e4d: benchmarks/external/ schema + 4-source converter + suite-v2.json 36 cases; suite-v1 byte-frozen)
remaining_env_blockers: ENV-NV1 (Docker runtime network isolation verification for api/worker)
ENV-MODEL (cloud/enterprise API keys not persisted in repo; 7B local baseline had rca_top1=0.222)

global_invariants.rule: Never bypass ToolGateway, ApprovalService.consume (atomic single-use + digest binding), or PolicyEngine for any write/R2+ action.

Maintain strict credential and network separation: Model services (model_net or external BYOK APIs) and model prompts must never receive database DSNs or raw DB credentials; Worker must not join model_net.
Enforce RedactionGate across all external, evidence, report, knowledge/wiki, and training-sample export channels before persistence or sending payloads to external BYOK LLM APIs.

Preserve append-only immutability on task_events, step_prepared, step_observed, approval_consumptions, evidence, knowledge_entries, and audit logs. R2+ execution must fail closed if audit emission fails.
Never expose benchmark Oracle ground truth (benchmarks/faults/oracle/) to Agent runtime, Evidence, logs, Wiki drafts, or training samples.

Never fabricate evaluation, performance, or runtime verification metrics. Keep unmeasured values null/UNKNOWN/NOT_EXECUTED until actually executed. Avoid forbidden fabrication words (预计/估计/约) and ORACLE_FORBIDDEN_FIELDS (fault_seed/expected_root_cause) in BaselineReport text.
Memory/Knowledge/Wiki must never hold tool_registry, gateway, or DSN references and cannot authorize write execution.

No silent self-evolution: learned knowledge/Wiki entries, BYOK model provider cutovers, or optional SFT model promotions require Machine Gate + Two-Person Multi-Confirmation (reviewer_2 != reviewer_1) with audit trail and rollback.

BYOK Security: Enterprise-supplied LLM API keys must be encrypted at rest and masked in all responses/logs/audits; user-supplied base_url values must pass strict SSRF validation (blocking loopback, link-local 169.254.0.0/16, control_net/lab_net internal hosts unless explicitly allowlisted).

pillars.name: Enterprise BYOK Model API Management, SSRF Guard & Protocol Compatibility
pillars.why_needed: Currently OpenAICompatibleAdapter reads global .env settings at startup; apps/api/routes/ has no runtime API for enterprises to register, test, or switch their own LLM APIs per tenant.

tasks.title: Multi-tenant Model Provider Registry & Management API (/v1/model-providers)
implementation_steps: Add control DB table (tenant_model_providers) storing per-tenant provider_id, name, provider_type (openai_compat / azure_openai / anthropic_compat / disabled), base_url, encrypted api_key, role_models JSON (planner/classifier/evaluator/embedding), timeout_s, stream flag, and active status.

Expose RBAC-protected REST endpoints: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /v1/model-providers, POST /v1/model-providers/{id}/test (connectivity + structured-output probe), and POST /v1/model-providers/{id}/activate.

Encrypt api_key using envelope/Fernet key from env (DG_SECRET_MASTER_KEY), return masked preview only (e.g. sk-***1234), and resolve ModelGateway per tenant_id in apps/api/routes/agent.py and workers/ instead of static global settings.
acceptance_criteria: Two tenants can configure distinct LLM APIs without server restart and never see each other's providers (cross-tenant 404).
API responses, audit events, and logs contain zero plaintext API keys.

tasks.title: Strict SSRF Guard, Egress Control & Token Quota Guardrails
implementation_steps: Validate base_url scheme (https required in prod; http allowlisted only for explicit dev/trusted internal subnets) and resolve DNS before connecting to block loopback (127.0.0.0/8), link-local/cloud metadata (169.254.0.0/16), and control_net/lab_net database ports.
Add per-tenant token/call rate-limit & cost-budget enforcement inside ModelGateway so runaway loops or misconfigured external APIs fail closed cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: Registering http://169.254.169.254 or control_db host as base_url is rejected with structured error.
Exceeding tenant token/call budget aborts gracefully and emits audit event.

tasks.title: Adaptive Schema Protocol Degradation & Multi-Provider Compatibility
implementation_steps: Support 3-tier automatic protocol fallback for enterprise gateways (OneAPI/LiteLLM/vLLM/Azure/Anthropic-proxy) that reject json_schema(strict): (1) json_schema(strict) -> (2) response_format=json_object -> (3) strict JSON prompt + deterministic fence-stripping parser + Pydantic validation (still fail-closed on invalid schema).
Support custom HTTP headers, optional custom CA bundle path, and configurable retry-on-429/503 with exponential backoff within wall-clock deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Mocked endpoints returning 400 on json_schema automatically negotiate down to json_object or prompt-JSON without crashing AgentLoop.
Invalid JSON from model still fails closed as MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID.

pillars.name: Close W11 Debt, Expand Controlled Repairs & Load Real External Corpora

tasks.title: Close W11 backup/negative-set technical debt (KD-W11-01/02/03)
implementation_steps: Include approval_consumptions and step_prepared in BACKUP_OBJECT_TABLES (5 tables total) and align audit_chain bucket naming.
Seed non-empty records across all backup/restore categories and replace sentinel IDs in negative-set groups G1-G3 with real seeded objects so AC-03 proves non-mutation on real rows.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 append-only/control tables verified non-empty before and after restore.
All 29 negative cases assert real target-row non-mutation.

tasks.title: Expand controlled repair playbooks, fix core loop PARTIAL handling & W08 KD-1
implementation_steps: Address P2-T1 leftover: ensure AgentLoop handles tool PARTIAL (truncated with valid data and no error) cleanly across both engines rather than terminating early.

Add scoped R2 repair tools behind explicit ToolDefinition contracts with mandatory VerificationPlan and CompensationPlan, plus pre-flight EXPLAIN/dry-run and blast-radius thresholds inside ToolGateway.
Emit COMPENSATION_DENIED consistently when compensation reusing original approval is rejected by Gateway (closing W08 KD-1).
acceptance_criteria: Truncated read tools allow AgentLoop to continue reasoning without false failure.
Each new repair action passes approval -> digest check -> execution -> independent verification -> compensation/rejection E2E tests.

tasks.title: Ingest local/offline external benchmark corpora into suite-v2 (when corpus files provided)
implementation_steps: Provide CLI/script accepting local downloaded JSONL snapshots from DiagDBench (RUCKBReasoning/DiagDBench), D-Bot (TsinghuaDatabaseGroup/DB-GPT), BIRD-CRITIC-1 (bird-bench/BIRD-CRITIC-1), and BenchBase (cmu-db/benchbase) so environments without direct GitHub access can attach real external scenarios to suite-v2.
acceptance_criteria: Attaching local corpus files produces valid suite-v2 manifests with zero Oracle leakage and suite-v1 byte-unchanged.

pillars.name: Knowledge Self-Evolution (LLM Wiki + Hybrid RAG) & Multi-Confirmation Workbench
pillars.why_needed: Replaces model fine-tuning for enterprise BYOK deployments: any connected model API learns enterprise-specific DB schemas, runbooks, and incident patterns via multi-confirmed LLM Wiki & RAG.

tasks.title: Upgrade MemoryService & Evolution Pipeline to 3-Gate Multi-Confirmation (N-of-M Sign-off)
implementation_steps: Add multi-confirmation state machine for evolution candidates (knowledge/Wiki entries, dataset batches, and BYOK model cutovers): PROPOSED -> MACHINE_VERIFIED -> REVIEW_STAGE_1 (DBA/Reviewer-1) -> APPROVED_ACTIVE (Owner/Security Reviewer-2 != Reviewer-1) -> REVOKED.
Enforce Gate 1 (Machine Gate): RedactionGate + Oracle zero-leak check + ConflictResolver check (and for model cutover: benchmark gate score >= threshold).

Enforce Gate 2 & Gate 3 (Dual Human Confirmation): distinct authenticated principals (reviewer_2.user_id != reviewer_1.user_id, DB-authoritative RBAC, bound to candidate content_digest) + one-click REVOKE rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Same user attempting both stage-1 and stage-2 confirmation is rejected fail-closed.
Content modification after stage-1 invalidates stage-1 sign-off.
Unconfirmed or single-confirmed knowledge never enters INDEXED retrieval.

tasks.title: Build LLM Wiki Compiler, Hybrid RAG & Wire Approved Knowledge into AgentLoop/ContextBuilder
implementation_steps: After a diagnostic task terminates, run a post-task Wiki Synthesizer (using the tenant's BYOK model API) on redacted reports/evidence to emit structured Wiki drafts (FaultPattern / Runbook / SchemaNote) in PROPOSED status only.

Implement EmbeddingAdapter HTTP transport (OpenAI-compatible /embeddings via BYOK provider, or local/BM25 fallback when embedding endpoint is not configured) + hybrid retrieval gated FIRST by MemoryResolver 8-stage hard filters (tenant_id, db_engine, db_version, adapter_version, capabilities, environment_fingerprint, risk_level, indexable_at).
Wire ContextBuilder and AgentLoop to inject top-k INDEXED (multi-confirmed) Wiki/knowledge entries into prompts with evidence_id citations, keeping INV-07 zero-execution-authority.
acceptance_criteria: AgentLoop uses multi-confirmed INDEXED Wiki knowledge during diagnosis and excludes PROPOSED/REVOKED/CONFLICTED/cross-tenant/cross-engine entries.
Post-task synthesis never bypasses RedactionGate or auto-promotes to INDEXED.

tasks.title: Build Web Console & Multi-Confirmation Evolution Workbench (apps/web/)
implementation_steps: Expose /v1/evolution/* APIs: list pending Wiki/knowledge drafts, candidate model cutovers, and curated case batches; inspect redacted diff, evidence chain, and benchmark results; execute Stage-1 confirm, Stage-2 confirm, Reject, or Revoke.

Scaffold apps/web/ (React+Vite+TypeScript or Next.js) with core enterprise views: (1) BYOK Model Provider Settings & Live Test Console; (2) Multi-Confirmation Evolution Workbench (two-person sign-off queue + evidence/diff viewer); (3) Task Diagnosis Timeline & R2 Repair Approval Workbench; (4) Audit Chain Verifier.
acceptance_criteria: Operator configures an enterprise model API in Web UI, runs a diagnosis, reviews the generated Wiki draft across two distinct human accounts, sees it improve the next diagnosis, and can revoke it.

pillars.name: Enterprise Identity (SSO), S3 Object Lock WORM & Active Observability

tasks.title: Add OIDC / SSO authentication provider with DB-authoritative RBAC
implementation_steps: Implement OIDC JWT/JWKS validation and external subject-to-local-principal mapping (ensuring real distinct reviewer_1 / reviewer_2 identities in P3-T1), keeping roles and tenant permissions strictly DB-authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: All W05 RBAC/cross-tenant 404 negative tests stay green; tampered/unmapped JWTs fail closed.

tasks.title: Implement S3/MinIO Object Lock WORM archive sink
implementation_steps: Implement ObjectStorageArchiveSink with S3 Object Lock retention headers and add optional MinIO service profile in docker-compose.yml.
acceptance_criteria: Overwrite/delete within retention window is rejected by MinIO/S3 and verified by audit_verify.py.

tasks.title: Integrate OpenTelemetry tracing & Prometheus metrics scraping
implementation_steps: Instrument FastAPI, WorkerRunner, ToolGateway, and ModelGateway (including BYOK latency/token/error metrics) with redacted OTel spans + Prometheus /metrics.
Extend AppTelemetryAdapter to ingest live Prometheus snapshots while retaining strict 6-key allowlist and UNKNOWN fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics/traces contain zero SQL literals, DSN secrets, or BYOK API keys.

pillars.name: BYOK Model Acceptance Evaluation Platform & Data Feedback Pipeline

tasks.title: Persistent Evaluation Middle-Platform & 'Test Before Go-Live' BYOK Gate
implementation_steps: Persist eval_suites, eval_runs, eval_case_results, and BYOK model/Wiki version comparisons in control DB.

Provide an API & Web UI button 'Evaluate Model Candidate' so when an enterprise plugs in a new API/model or updates Wiki knowledge, it automatically runs the benchmark suite, computes 14 metrics + bootstrap CI, and feeds results into P3-T1's Machine Gate before cutover confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Enterprises can compare two model APIs or Wiki snapshots side-by-side in Web UI before promoting one to active.

tasks.title: Automated Data Feedback Pipeline (and OPTIONAL isolated LoRA SFT export)
implementation_steps: Automatically curate multi-confirmed resolved sessions via build_training_sample() -> clean_dataset() -> split_samples() into versioned golden regression datasets (for P5-T1) and optional SFT exports.
OPTIONAL (skip unless deploying a dedicated small on-prem appliance): run offline LoRA fine-tuning under an isolated name (e.g. dbguardian-7b-sft-v1) without touching shared weights.
acceptance_criteria: Exported golden regression cases pass RedactionGate and zero-Oracle-leak checks.

pillars.name: Containerized Isolation, Physical Backup/Restore & Multi-Worker Soak

tasks.title: Enforce strict container network isolation and verify runtime topology (close ENV-NV1)
implementation_steps: Remove transitional lab_net from api in docker-compose.yml, build API/Worker/Web containers, record immutable SHA-256 digests, and run live cross-network negative probes.
acceptance_criteria: container_runtime_status == VERIFIED and image_digest != UNKNOWN.

tasks.title: Physical backup/restore, multi-worker HA failover & soak test toward ALPHA
implementation_steps: Resolve DG_ADMIN_DSN (ENV-1045) in test environment, run physical backup/restore & migration drills, execute >= 3600s multi-worker concurrent soak with crash failover, and re-run publish_decision() -> derive_release_type().
acceptance_criteria: SoakReport.status == COMPLETED with measured p50/p95 and zero duplicate R2 writes.
publish_decision() reaches ALPHA_ALLOWED.

execution_order_for_ai_agent: 1. Execute P1_BYOK_MODEL_API_PLATFORM (P1-BYOK-T1, T2, T3) so enterprises can dynamically configure, SSRF-validate, probe, and switch their own LLM APIs per tenant with adaptive JSON-protocol fallback.

2. Execute P2-T2 and P2-T3 (close W11 technical debt KD-W11-01/02/03, fix core loop PARTIAL truncation handling, expand controlled repair actions + W08 KD-1; optionally run P2-T4 when local external corpora are supplied).

3. Execute P3-T1, P3-T2, and P3-T3 (3-Gate Multi-Confirmation + LLM Wiki + Hybrid RAG wired into AgentLoop + Web Confirmation Workbench in apps/web/) so BYOK models improve continuously via human-confirmed knowledge without training weights.
4. Execute P5-T1 and P5-T2 (Evaluation Middle-Platform 'Test Before Go-Live' BYOK comparison + automated golden dataset feedback; leave LoRA SFT strictly optional).

5. Execute P4 (OIDC SSO, S3 Object Lock WORM, OTel/Prometheus) and P6 (Docker runtime network isolation ENV-NV1, physical backup/restore ENV-1045, multi-worker soak test) to promote release tier from TECH_PREVIEW to ALPHA.
